title: normalized_midpoint
guidance: A midpoint-normalized difference is a ratio: absolute difference / midpoint. Keep decimal scale; multiply by 100 only if explicitly requested. Round once at the end.

title: series_scope
goal: Statistics on exactly the requested observations
guidance: List the requested periods before collecting values; exclude other rows even if nearby. Pair series by period. Sample variance uses n-1; population uses n. Missing values are not zero.

title: annual_log
guidance: Continuous annual growth is ln(end/start)/elapsed intervals. Use matching endpoint categories; count time intervals, not inclusive observations. The result is a decimal rate.

title: compound_growth
guidance: CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed intervals)-1. Keep endpoint units and categories identical. A growth factor is 1+CAGR; multiply a rate by 100 only for percent output.

title: regression_coordinates
goal: Preserve regression coordinates and error direction
guidance: Use the stated predictor: numeric year and zero-based year index have different intercepts. Exclude forecast dates from fitting. Apply the requested actual-minus-forecast or reverse order literally.

title: price_basis
guidance: For constant-price conversion: nominal amount * target CPI / observation CPI. Match each period to the requested monthly or annual-average index; do not invert the ratio or mix index series.

title: table_groups
guidance: Keep blank cells and group headers when parsing tables; removing nonnumeric cells shifts columns. Identify the value by its year and category header, not publication date or numeric position.
